translation.en: Most Serene Prince! Most gracious Prince and Lord! Your Most Serene Highness's command of the 31st of last month I received today. Tomorrow morning I shall go to the Count von Schulenburg, deliver to him the letter addressed to him and await his further declaration. By the next post I shall not fail to submit in most humble [submission] the result of my conference. In deepest reverence I remain, until death, Your Most Serene Highness's Berlin, the 3rd Nov. 1834. most humble and obedient servant Amelang

text_english: Most Serene Prince! Most gracious Prince and Lord! Your Most Serene Highness's command of the 31st of last month I received today. Tomorrow morning I shall go to the Count von Schulenburg, deliver to him the letter addressed to him and await his further declaration. By the next post I shall not fail to submit in most humble [submission] the result of my conference. In deepest reverence I remain, until death, Your Most Serene Highness's Berlin, the 3rd Nov. 1834. most humble and obedient servant Amelang
summary_en: Acknowledgement by Amelang, writing from Berlin, that the Prince's instruction of the 31st of the previous month has arrived; he will call on Count von Schulenburg the following morning to hand over the letter addressed to him, hear his declaration, and report the outcome of the conference by the next post. A brief covering note containing no other business.
summary_de: Bestätigt den Empfang des fürstlichen Befehls vom 31. des vorigen Monats und kündigt an, am folgenden Morgen zum Grafen von Schulenburg zu gehen, ihm das an ihn gerichtete Schreiben zu übergeben und seine Erklärung abzuwarten; über das Ergebnis der Unterredung werde mit der nächsten Post berichtet. Unterzeichnet von Amelang, nicht von Triebenfeld; das Stück fällt mit 1834 aus dem Zeitraum der übrigen Briefe heraus.
